about: What each outlet published on the storm and when (one row per item; the title as published, with its link; the kind of by-line, never a name). The item's URL is its source. From incident.media@'s coverage.json. Built by tools/graph-build.mjs from the incident's JSON; every row carries label, source, read and origin. Not a warning service. In 2 files: this is part 2.
